title_en: Near Zogu te Black, at "Lion Residences 2", Super Apartment 1+1 with Perfect Orientation for Sale!!
description_en: Near Zogu te Black, at "Lion Residences 2", Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, Ideal for investment!! The apartment has an area of ​​80.52 m2 and is located on the 19th residential floor of a new complex under construction. Lion Residence 2 is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services.
